faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulbari?
faq.a: Abdulbari is associated with Arabic. Abdulbari is Arabic عَبْدُ الْبَارِي (ʿAbd al-Bārī), meaning 'servant of the Creator'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْبَارِي is Arabic.
Abdulbari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulbari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Bārī is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulbari mean in Persian?
